0022600167.text: The Boston Celtics (5-1, on a five-game winning streak) visit the Houston Rockets (6-1, on a one-game winning streak) as both teams look to stay near the top of their divisions. Boston is out Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with a game-time decision (rest), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), with Reed Sheppard day-to-day and a game-time decision (back). The teams have no games yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Boston winning the last meeting 114-93 in Houston on February 4, 2026.
